subject: Convoy: retry surge, 5xx/429 spike — remediation timeline & credit proposal
messages:
From: Ava Thompson <ava@convoy.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Ops Team <ops@convoy.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 20:03:00 -0700
Subject: High 5xx/429 spike affecting Convoy production (started 18:42 UTC)

Hi Mateo —

We started seeing a rapid spike in 5xx/429 responses across our inference traffic at ~18:42 UTC. Client SDKs report timeouts and exponential retries; over the next 14 minutes our frontdoor saw a ~38% increase in downstream traffic due to client retries. This impacted task assignment flows and caused downstream backpressure.

Quick summary: 
- Window: 18:42–19:05 UTC
- Error types: 5xx (502/503) and 429s from Redwood endpoints
- Visible impact: latency spikes (p95 > 5s) and increased tail-latency timeouts
- Business impact: multiple customers reported failures; several orders delayed in that window

Can you confirm root cause and whether Redwood will provide credits for the outage window? We need a timeline for remediation steps and a proposed credit so we can present to leadership.

Attachments: incident logs snapshot (convoy_error_snapshot.zip)

Thanks,
Ava
Ava Thompson
Head of Platform Reliability, Convoy AI
[Attachment: convoy_error_snapshot.zip]
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Ava Thompson <ava@convoy.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 20:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: High 5xx/429 spike affecting Convoy production (started 18:42 UTC)

Ava — thank you for the heads up and for the log bundle. I'm escalating this to infra and ops immediately. Initial notes: our monitoring shows a short-lived retry amplification originating from a routing mismatch on our autoscaler; that led to request overflow on a subset of replicas and subsequent 429s as queue limits were reached. The engineering team is running a deeper postmortem.

Next steps (immediate):
- Dylan to confirm exact subset of hosts and capacity behavior (ETA 60m)
- Vanessa to pull per-customer token counts for the window (ETA 90m)
- We will share a proposed credit calc by EOD and a draft postmortem in 24 hours.

I'm copying our account lead (Vanessa) and escalation ops (Dylan) to coordinate credit and communications. We understand the business impact and want to move quickly.

- Mateo
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proposed_credit_calc.xlsx]
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ava Thompson <ava@convoy.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 21:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: High 5xx/429 spike affecting Convoy production (started 18:42 UTC)

Updating with ops findings: 
- Root cause: race condition between scale-up policy and routing table updates during a transient surge from one of Convoy's heavy lanes. Autoscaler brought up instances but a partial routing table misconfiguration caused ~30% of traffic to be dropped or backpressured. That produced 429s and a short burst of 502/503 as overloaded replicas returned errors.
- Duration: 18:42–18:58 UTC for most affected replicas; cascading retries extended observed client impact to ~19:05 UTC.
- Affected shard ids: rwi-12, rwi-13, rwi-15 (we found traces in the attached snapshot).

Mitigations applied: disabled the immediate scale policy tweak, forced a consistent routing refresh, and enabled a short-term queuing bump to reduce head-of-line drops. We will deliver a permanent routing validation in the next release (ETA 2 weeks).

I'll attach the per-host logs and a rough token-count estimate for Convoy (attached).

- Dylan
SRE, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: host-traces-rwi-12-15.log]
From: Ava Thompson <ava@convoy.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Ops Team <ops@convoy.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 22:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: High 5xx/429 spike affecting Convoy production (started 18:42 UTC)

Thanks for the immediate investigation and mitigation. Leadership is asking for a credit proposal that is simple and defensible — they want the estimated dollar impact on their side and a Redwood goodwill credit for the service disruption. Can you propose something we can put on the exec deck by tomorrow morning?

Also: please flag if there are any risks of recurrence in the next 30 days — Convoy wants to know whether to shift critical lanes off Redwood until the fix is in.

- Ava
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Ava Thompson <ava@convoy.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 07:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Convoy credit proposal and mitigation plan

Ava — good morning. Attached is a conservative credit proposal and the methodology we used (see proposed_credit_calc.xlsx). Summary:
- Affected window used for credit calculation: 18:42–19:05 UTC (23 minutes)
- Credit offered: 15% of billed inference consumption for that window, applied as account credit on next invoice OR as an immediate one-time invoice adjustment (your choice).
- Rationale: the credit acknowledges service degradation while balancing per-customer token accounting, retries that amplified traffic, and root-cause attribution to an internal routing/scale coordination bug.

Risk/recurrence: root cause is fixed in the short-term with routing refresh and queuing bump. There is a code change to add a routing validation step that ships in 2 weeks and a follow-up runbook update in 3 days. Residual risk over the next 30 days is low; we propose a joint runbook review with Convoy ops this week.

If that aligns, we can have a signature-ready credit memo and an internal SLA exception ticket created today.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proposed_credit_calc.xlsx]
From: Ethan Miles <ethan.miles@convoy.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Thompson <ava@convoy.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 08:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Convoy credit proposal and mitigation plan

Thanks Vanessa. Leadership prefers an immediate invoice adjustment rather than a future credit. Two follow-ups: 
1) Can you send the exact credit amount in dollars (we'll want it on the exec slide)?
2) We need a commitment that critical lanes will have the routing validation deployed before we resume transfer of peak traffic (ETA in writing).

Also, please include a one-paragraph incident summary we can paste into our postmortem.

Ethan
Director of Site Reliability, Convoy AI
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Miles <ethan.miles@convoy.ai>, Ava Thompson <ava@convoy.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: Credit amount and deployment commitment

Ethan / Ava — closing the loop. Per the token accounting and your billing rates, the immediate invoice adjustment equals $9,750 (details in attached spreadsheet). We're prepared to issue that as an immediate adjustment on your current invoice and to create a signed credit memo.

Deployment commitment: routing validation code is staged and scheduled for rollout on 2026-09-22 (non-peak window). We will run a joint validation test on 09-21 with Convoy ops. If any issues are found during the staging test, we will hold and remediate with an agreed rollback plan.

One-paragraph incident summary you can paste: 
"Between 18:42–18:58 UTC on 2026-09-14, an autoscaler/routing coordination bug caused partial routing table mismatches that produced 429 and transient 5xx errors for a subset of replicas. Client retries amplified traffic and extended customer-visible disruption to ~19:05 UTC. Immediate mitigations reduced the surface area; a permanent routing validation will be deployed 2026-09-22 and joint validation testing will occur 2026-09-21."

Next steps we will take today: issue invoice adjustment ("$9,750"), create SLA exception ticket, and schedule the joint runbook review.

If that works, reply with confirmation and we will start the paperwork.

Thanks,
Vanessa
[Attachment: proposed_credit_calc.xlsx]
